title: campus-lab: US spelling (data center, analyzed, normalized, behavior)
body:
## Summary

Wording only: `centre → center`, `analysed → analyzed`, `normalised → normalized`, `behaviour → behavior`, `modelled → modeled`, across the README, templates, tests, exporter, page and exported `data.json`.

Two interface descriptions and two ACL comments in the templates change, so `build/configs/*.cfg` are re-rendered (CI's drift check requires it) and `data.json` re-exported — the build digest in the footer changes accordingly. 92 tests still pass; ansible-lint clean.
